title: RREP hop_count unbounded - input validation gap
description: Location: loadng.rs line 418. Unlike RREQ hop_limit which is clamped to MAX_HOP_LIMIT (15), RREP hop_count is read verbatim without validation. A misbehaving signed node could send hop_count=0 to manipulate route selection if routing prefers lower hop_count. Fix: hop_count = data[1].min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT)
close_reason: Fixed: Added hop_count clamping in RREP::from_bytes() with .min(MAX_HOP_LIMIT) to prevent route preference manipulation. Added 3 tests mirroring RREQ hop_limit pattern.
